items.question: Trong câu "Traceable is a property of a requirement: it has a unique persistent label, is written fine-grained, and is not combined with other requirements.", từ "persistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Traceable is a property of a requirement: it has a unique persistent label, is written fine-grained, and is not combined with other requirements.", what does "persistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: persistent /pəˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): tồn tại lâu, không đổi. "Persistent identifier/storage" = định danh/lưu trữ bền vững; với người, persistent là kiên trì.
items.explanationEn: persistent /pəˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): lasting and unchanging. "Persistent identifier" or "persistent storage" lasts over time; for people, persistent means determined.

items.question: Trong câu "Writing fine-grained requirements with persistent labels costs almost nothing extra; creating and maintaining links does.", từ "fine-grained" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Writing fine-grained requirements with persistent labels costs almost nothing extra; creating and maintaining links does.", what does "fine-grained" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fine-grained /ˌfaɪn ˈɡreɪnd/ (tính từ): chi tiết, chia nhỏ. "Fine-grained" trái nghĩa "coarse-grained"; hay dùng: "fine-grained permissions".
items.explanationEn: fine-grained /ˌfaɪn ˈɡreɪnd/ (adjective): broken into small detailed parts. Fine-grained is the opposite of coarse-grained; common in "fine-grained permissions".

items.question: Trong câu "A requirements-to-tests matrix immediately shows which requirements have no test (a coverage gap) and which tests trace to no requirement (a superfluous test or an unrecorded requirement).", từ "superfluous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A requirements-to-tests matrix immediately shows which requirements have no test (a coverage gap) and which tests trace to no requirement (a superfluous test or an unrecorded requirement).", what does "superfluous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: superfluous /suːˈpɜːfluəs/ (tính từ): thừa, không cần thiết. "Superfluous" = dư thừa; gần nghĩa "redundant", "unnecessary".
items.explanationEn: superfluous /suːˈpɜːfluəs/ (adjective): unnecessary, more than needed. Superfluous means extra and unneeded; close to redundant and unnecessary.

items.question: Trong câu "Code linked to no requirement → possibly gold plating, or an unrecorded implicit requirement.", từ "implicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Code linked to no requirement → possibly gold plating, or an unrecorded implicit requirement.", what does "implicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: implicit /ɪmˈplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): ngầm hiểu, không nói ra. "Implicit" trái nghĩa "explicit"; "implicit requirement" = yêu cầu ngầm định chưa được ghi lại.
items.explanationEn: implicit /ɪmˈplɪsɪt/ (adjective): understood but not stated. Implicit is the opposite of explicit; an "implicit requirement" is assumed but never written.

items.question: Trong câu "Years later, a maintainer needs to know which requirement this strange piece of code serves before daring to change it.", từ "dare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Years later, a maintainer needs to know which requirement this strange piece of code serves before daring to change it.", what does "dare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dare /deər/ (động từ): dám (làm gì). "Dare to do something" = dám làm gì; "I dare you" = tôi thách bạn.
items.explanationEn: dare /deər/ (verb): to be brave enough to. "Dare to do something" means to have the courage; "I dare you" is a challenge.

items.question: Trong câu "For safety-critical systems or regulated domains, tracing is legally mandatory.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For safety-critical systems or regulated domains, tracing is legally mandatory.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmændətəri/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory" trái nghĩa "optional"; "mandatory field" = trường bắt buộc nhập.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmændətəri/ (adjective): required by rule. Mandatory is the opposite of optional; a "mandatory field" must be filled in.

items.question: Trong câu "You must demonstrate to a certification body that every safety requirement was implemented and verified.", từ "demonstrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You must demonstrate to a certification body that every safety requirement was implemented and verified.", what does "demonstrate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to show how a product works
items.explanation: demonstrate /ˈdemənstreɪt/ (động từ): chứng minh. "Demonstrate that..." = chứng minh rằng; "demo" là dạng rút gọn chỉ buổi trình diễn sản phẩm.
items.explanationEn: demonstrate /ˈdemənstreɪt/ (verb): to prove with evidence. "Demonstrate that..." means to prove; "demo" is the short form for a product showing.

items.question: Trong câu "Tracing is one of the most praised and most poorly executed practices in requirements engineering.", từ "execute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tracing is one of the most praised and most poorly executed practices in requirements engineering.", what does "execute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: execute /ˈeksɪkjuːt/ (động từ): thực hiện, triển khai. "Poorly executed" = thực hiện kém; trong lập trình "execute code" = chạy mã.
items.explanationEn: execute /ˈeksɪkjuːt/ (verb): to carry out. "Poorly executed" means done badly; in programming, "execute code" means to run it.

items.question: Trong câu "Reconstructing trace links after everything is finished is extremely expensive and usually produces wrong results.", từ "reconstruct" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reconstructing trace links after everything is finished is extremely expensive and usually produces wrong results.", what does "reconstruct" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reconstruct /ˌriːkənˈstrʌkt/ (động từ): dựng lại, tái tạo. "Reconstruct" = dựng lại từ thông tin rời rạc, như "reconstruct events".
items.explanationEn: reconstruct /ˌriːkənˈstrʌkt/ (verb): to build again from pieces. Reconstruct means to rebuild from scattered information, as in "reconstruct events".

items.question: Trong câu "It is done by hand in a spreadsheet and goes stale quickly.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is done by hand in a spreadsheet and goes stale quickly.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): lỗi thời, không cập nhật. "Go stale" = trở nên lỗi thời; "stale data/cache" = dữ liệu cũ.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date. "Go stale" means to become outdated; "stale data" or "stale cache" is out of date.

items.question: Trong câu "An out-of-date traceability matrix is worse than none — it manufactures false confidence.", từ "manufacture" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An out-of-date traceability matrix is worse than none — it manufactures false confidence.", what does "manufacture" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make goods in a factory
items.explanation: manufacture /ˌmænjuˈfæktʃər/ (động từ): tạo ra (một cách giả tạo). Nghĩa gốc là sản xuất trong nhà máy; nghĩa bóng là tạo ra điều không thật như "manufacture confidence".
items.explanationEn: manufacture /ˌmænjuˈfæktʃər/ (verb): to create artificially. Literally it means to make goods; figuratively it means to create something false.

items.question: Trong câu "It is done too finely, creating a maintenance burden nobody can sustain.", từ "burden" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is done too finely, creating a maintenance burden nobody can sustain.", what does "burden" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: burden /ˈbɜːdn/ (danh từ): gánh nặng. "Maintenance burden" = gánh nặng duy trì; trái nghĩa trong ngữ cảnh này là "asset".
items.explanationEn: burden /ˈbɜːdn/ (noun): a heavy duty or load. "Maintenance burden" is costly ongoing work; its opposite here is an asset.

items.question: Trong câu "A requirement that cannot be traced back to an authoritative source is a prime candidate for elimination.", từ "authoritative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A requirement that cannot be traced back to an authoritative source is a prime candidate for elimination.", what does "authoritative" (adjective) mean?
options: đáng tin cậy, có thẩm quyền
items.explanation: authoritative /ɔːˈθɒrətətɪv/ (tính từ): đáng tin cậy, có thẩm quyền. "Authoritative source" = nguồn có thẩm quyền; khác với "authoritarian" = độc đoán.
items.explanationEn: authoritative /ɔːˈθɒrətətɪv/ (adjective): reliable and official. An "authoritative source" is trusted; do not confuse it with authoritarian.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirement → downstream work products.", từ "downstream" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirement → downstream work products.", what does "downstream" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: at later stages of a process
items.explanation: downstream /ˌdaʊnˈstriːm/ (tính từ): ở các bước sau. "Downstream" = các bước phía sau trong quy trình; trái nghĩa "upstream".
items.explanationEn: downstream /ˌdaʊnˈstriːm/ (adjective): at later stages of a process. Downstream means later in a process; the opposite is upstream.

items.question: Trong câu "These relationships are NOT always one-to-one.", từ "one-to-one" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "These relationships are NOT always one-to-one.", what does "one-to-one" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: one-to-one /ˌwʌn tə ˈwʌn/ (tính từ): tương ứng một-một. "One-to-one relationship" = quan hệ một-một; còn có "one-to-many", "many-to-many".
items.explanationEn: one-to-one /ˌwʌn tə ˈwʌn/ (adjective): each item matches exactly one. A "one-to-one relationship" pairs single items; related: one-to-many, many-to-many.

items.question: Trong câu "The power of the matrix representation: gaps become VISIBLE.", từ "representation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The power of the matrix representation: gaps become VISIBLE.", what does "representation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: representation /ˌreprɪzenˈteɪʃən/ (danh từ): cách biểu diễn. "Matrix representation" = cách thể hiện dạng ma trận; "representation" còn là sự đại diện.
items.explanationEn: representation /ˌreprɪzenˈteɪʃən/ (noun): a way of showing something. "Matrix representation" is a way of displaying data; representation can also mean acting for others.

items.question: Trong câu "An empty row jumps out immediately, whereas the same information scattered through prose goes unnoticed.", từ "scatter" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An empty row jumps out immediately, whereas the same information scattered through prose goes unnoticed.", what does "scatter" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scatter /ˈskætər/ (động từ): rải rác, phân tán. "Scattered through/across" = nằm rải rác khắp; "scatter plot" = biểu đồ phân tán.
items.explanationEn: scatter /ˈskætər/ (verb): to spread in many places. "Scattered through" means spread around; a "scatter plot" is a type of chart.

items.question: Trong câu "When a BA decomposes a requirement, the parent-child link is created at the moment of decomposition.", từ "decompose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a BA decomposes a requirement, the parent-child link is created at the moment of decomposition.", what does "decompose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: decompose /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/ (động từ): phân rã, chia nhỏ. "Decompose a requirement/problem" = chia thành phần nhỏ hơn; nghĩa sinh học là phân huỷ.
items.explanationEn: decompose /ˌdiːkəmˈpəʊz/ (verb): to break into smaller parts. "Decompose a problem" means to split it into parts; biologically it means to rot.

items.question: Trong câu "The result is expensive, inaccurate, and trusted by nobody.", từ "inaccurate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result is expensive, inaccurate, and trusted by nobody.", what does "inaccurate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inaccurate /ɪnˈækjərət/ (tính từ): không chính xác. "Inaccurate" trái nghĩa "accurate"; danh từ "inaccuracy".
items.explanationEn: inaccurate /ɪnˈækjərət/ (adjective): not correct. Inaccurate is the opposite of accurate; noun: inaccuracy.

items.question: Trong câu "Tracing is a distributed responsibility, coordinated and checked by the BA.", từ "distributed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tracing is a distributed responsibility, coordinated and checked by the BA.", what does "distributed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (tính từ): được chia cho nhiều người. "Distributed responsibility" = trách nhiệm chia sẻ; "distributed system" = hệ thống phân tán.
items.explanationEn: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (adjective): shared among many people. "Distributed responsibility" is shared; a "distributed system" runs on many machines.

items.question: Trong câu "MAINTENANCE cost — this is the bulk of it.", từ "bulk" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "MAINTENANCE cost — this is the bulk of it.", what does "bulk" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: bulk /bʌlk/ (danh từ): phần lớn. "The bulk of" = phần lớn của; "buy in bulk" = mua số lượng lớn.
items.explanationEn: bulk /bʌlk/ (noun): the largest part. "The bulk of" means most of; "buy in bulk" means in large quantities.

items.question: Trong câu "Every time code is refactored, tests are rewritten, or requirements are modified, the links must be updated.", từ "refactor" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every time code is refactored, tests are rewritten, or requirements are modified, the links must be updated.", what does "refactor" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to restructure code without changing behavior
items.explanation: refactor /riːˈfæktər/ (động từ): tái cấu trúc mã. "Refactor" = cải thiện cấu trúc mã mà không đổi hành vi.
items.explanationEn: refactor /riːˈfæktər/ (verb): to restructure code without changing behavior. Refactor means improving code structure while keeping its behavior.

items.question: Trong câu "Maintenance cost scales with the number of LINKS, not the number of requirements.", từ "scale" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Maintenance cost scales with the number of LINKS, not the number of requirements.", what does "scale" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scale /skeɪl/ (động từ): tăng theo tỉ lệ. "Scale with X" = tăng tương ứng với X; "scale up/out" = mở rộng hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: scale /skeɪl/ (verb): to grow in proportion. "Scale with X" means to grow in proportion to X; "scale up" means to expand.

items.question: Trong câu "This is why over-detailed tracing becomes unsustainable very quickly.", từ "unsustainable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why over-detailed tracing becomes unsustainable very quickly.", what does "unsustainable" (adjective) mean?
options: không thể duy trì lâu dài
items.explanation: unsustainable /ˌʌnsəˈsteɪnəbl/ (tính từ): không thể duy trì lâu dài. "Unsustainable pace/cost" = nhịp độ/chi phí không thể duy trì; gốc "sustain" = duy trì.
items.explanationEn: unsustainable /ˌʌnsəˈsteɪnəbl/ (adjective): impossible to keep up long-term. "Unsustainable pace" cannot be maintained; the root verb is sustain.

items.question: Trong câu "A pragmatic test: for each link type you plan to maintain, ask", từ "pragmatic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pragmatic test: for each link type you plan to maintain, ask", what does "pragmatic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pragmatic /præɡˈmætɪk/ (tính từ): thực dụng, thiết thực. "A pragmatic approach" = cách tiếp cận thực tế, chú trọng hiệu quả hơn lý thuyết.
items.explanationEn: pragmatic /præɡˈmætɪk/ (adjective): practical and realistic. "A pragmatic approach" focuses on what works in practice rather than theory.

items.question: Trong câu "Trace at the appropriate GRANULARITY — link to a module instead of each function; link to a test suite instead of each test case, if that suffices.", từ "granularity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trace at the appropriate GRANULARITY — link to a module instead of each function; link to a test suite instead of each test case, if that suffices.", what does "granularity" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the grain size of a material
items.explanation: granularity /ˌɡrænjəˈlærəti/ (danh từ): mức độ chi tiết. "Granularity" = mức chia nhỏ; liên quan tính từ "fine-grained", "coarse-grained".
items.explanationEn: granularity /ˌɡrænjəˈlærəti/ (noun): the level of detail. Granularity is the level of detail; related adjectives: fine-grained, coarse-grained.

items.question: Trong câu "Trace at the appropriate GRANULARITY — link to a module instead of each function; link to a test suite instead of each test case, if that suffices.", từ "suffice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trace at the appropriate GRANULARITY — link to a module instead of each function; link to a test suite instead of each test case, if that suffices.", what does "suffice" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suffice /səˈfaɪs/ (động từ): đủ, đáp ứng được. "If that suffices" = nếu thế là đủ; tính từ "sufficient".
items.explanationEn: suffice /səˈfaɪs/ (verb): to be enough. "If that suffices" means if that is enough; adjective: sufficient.

items.question: Trong câu "The telltale sign: the traceability matrix is updated only when an audit is coming.", từ "telltale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The telltale sign: the traceability matrix is updated only when an audit is coming.", what does "telltale" (adjective) mean?
options: để lộ, tiết lộ sự thật
items.explanation: telltale /ˈtelteɪl/ (tính từ): để lộ, tiết lộ sự thật. "A telltale sign" = dấu hiệu để lộ ra vấn đề ẩn bên dưới.
items.explanationEn: telltale /ˈtelteɪl/ (adjective): revealing something hidden. "A telltale sign" is a clue that reveals a hidden problem.

items.question: Trong câu "This vicious circle is only broken when tracing delivers IMMEDIATE value to the people creating it — mainly through fast, accurate impact analysis.", từ "vicious circle" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This vicious circle is only broken when tracing delivers IMMEDIATE value to the people creating it — mainly through fast, accurate impact analysis.", what does "vicious circle" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: vicious circle /ˌvɪʃəs ˈsɜːkl/ (cụm từ): vòng luẩn quẩn. "Vicious circle" = vòng luẩn quẩn, vấn đề này gây ra vấn đề kia; ngược lại là "virtuous circle".
items.explanationEn: vicious circle /ˌvɪʃəs ˈsɜːkl/ (phrase): a bad cycle that repeats. A "vicious circle" is where problems feed each other; the opposite is a "virtuous circle".

items.question: Trong câu "Trace shallowly or not at all for the rest.", từ "shallowly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trace shallowly or not at all for the rest.", what does "shallowly" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: not deeply, at a surface level
items.explanation: shallowly /ˈʃæləʊli/ (trạng từ): một cách sơ sài, nông. "Shallowly" trái nghĩa "deeply"; tính từ "shallow" = nông.
items.explanationEn: shallowly /ˈʃæləʊli/ (adverb): not deeply, at a surface level. Shallowly is the opposite of deeply; adjective: shallow.

items.question: Trong câu "The key insight: the best tracing is tracing created as a SIDE EFFECT of normal work, not as a separate activity.", từ "side effect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key insight: the best tracing is tracing created as a SIDE EFFECT of normal work, not as a separate activity.", what does "side effect" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an unwanted effect of a drug
items.explanation: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (danh từ): kết quả phụ đi kèm. "As a side effect of" = như một kết quả phụ; trong y học là tác dụng phụ, trong lập trình là hiệu ứng phụ của hàm.
items.explanationEn: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (noun): a secondary result. "As a side effect of" means as an extra result; in medicine it is an unwanted drug effect.

items.question: Trong câu "If the team discards user stories after implementation, the backward link to the business rationale disappears.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the team discards user stories after implementation, the backward link to the business rationale disappears.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. "Discard changes" = huỷ bỏ thay đổi; hay gặp trong Git và giao diện phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. "Discard changes" means to throw them away; common in Git and editors.

items.question: Trong câu "Links to high-level requirements (business objectives) are often weak, because a flat backlog does not express that structure well.", từ "flat" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Links to high-level requirements (business objectives) are often weak, because a flat backlog does not express that structure well.", what does "flat" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: flat /flæt/ (tính từ): không phân cấp. "Flat backlog/structure" = danh sách không phân cấp; "flat rate" = giá cố định.
items.explanationEn: flat /flæt/ (adjective): without levels or hierarchy. A "flat backlog" has no hierarchy; a "flat rate" is a fixed price.

items.question: Trong câu "Every piece of code must trace back to a requirement — code without a requirement is a serious audit finding.", từ "finding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every piece of code must trace back to a requirement — code without a requirement is a serious audit finding.", what does "finding" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an issue found by a review
items.explanation: finding /ˈfaɪndɪŋ/ (danh từ): điểm phát hiện (khi kiểm tra). "Audit finding" = vấn đề được phát hiện qua kiểm toán; "research findings" = kết quả nghiên cứu.
items.explanationEn: finding /ˈfaɪndɪŋ/ (noun): an issue found by a review. An "audit finding" is an issue an audit discovers; "research findings" are results.

items.question: Trong câu "Evidence must be produced THROUGHOUT the project, with timestamps, not assembled at the end.", từ "assemble" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Evidence must be produced THROUGHOUT the project, with timestamps, not assembled at the end.", what does "assemble" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to build a machine from parts
items.explanation: assemble /əˈsembl/ (động từ): gom lại, tập hợp. "Assemble evidence" = gom bằng chứng; "assemble furniture" = lắp ráp đồ.
items.explanationEn: assemble /əˈsembl/ (verb): to gather together. "Assemble evidence" means to gather it; "assemble furniture" means to put it together.

items.question: Trong câu "This is why in regulated domains a requirements management tool is not a luxury but a precondition.", từ "precondition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why in regulated domains a requirements management tool is not a luxury but a precondition.", what does "precondition" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precondition /ˌpriːkənˈdɪʃən/ (danh từ): điều kiện tiên quyết. "A precondition for X" = điều kiện phải có trước X; trong kiểm thử có "preconditions" của test case.
items.explanationEn: precondition /ˌpriːkənˈdɪʃən/ (noun): something required first. "A precondition for X" must exist before X; test cases also list preconditions.

items.question: Trong câu "Many-to-many relationships cannot be expressed in a linear document", từ "linear" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many-to-many relationships cannot be expressed in a linear document", what does "linear" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: linear /ˈlɪniər/ (tính từ): tuyến tính, theo một mạch. "Linear document" = tài liệu đọc từ đầu đến cuối; "linear search" = tìm kiếm tuần tự.
items.explanationEn: linear /ˈlɪniər/ (adjective): arranged in a single sequence. A "linear document" is read start to end; "linear search" checks items in order.

items.question: Trong câu "Copy and paste, producing many out-of-sync versions", từ "out-of-sync" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copy and paste, producing many out-of-sync versions", what does "out-of-sync" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: out-of-sync /ˌaʊt əv ˈsɪŋk/ (tính từ): không đồng bộ, lệch nhau. "Out of sync" = không còn khớp nhau; "keep in sync" = giữ đồng bộ.
items.explanationEn: out-of-sync /ˌaʊt əv ˈsɪŋk/ (adjective): not matching each other. "Out of sync" means no longer matching; "keep in sync" means to keep them matching.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements that logically belong in several places must be repeated", từ "logically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements that logically belong in several places must be repeated", what does "logically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: logically /ˈlɒdʒɪkli/ (trạng từ): về mặt logic, hợp lẽ. "Logically belong" = hợp lý thuộc về; đối lập với "physically" (vị trí thực tế).
items.explanationEn: logically /ˈlɒdʒɪkli/ (adverb): in terms of reasoning. "Logically belong" refers to meaning, as opposed to physical location.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no natural place to put 8 attributes per requirement without making the document unreadable", từ "unreadable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no natural place to put 8 attributes per requirement without making the document unreadable", what does "unreadable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unreadable /ʌnˈriːdəbl/ (tính từ): khó đọc, không đọc được. "Unreadable" = khó đọc do trình bày rối hoặc chữ khó nhìn.
items.explanationEn: unreadable /ʌnˈriːdəbl/ (adjective): too hard to read. Unreadable means too cluttered or unclear to read.

items.question: Trong câu "The founding principle: requirements are fundamentally STRUCTURED, RELATED DATA, not prose.", từ "prose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The founding principle: requirements are fundamentally STRUCTURED, RELATED DATA, not prose.", what does "prose" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prose /prəʊz/ (danh từ): văn xuôi, văn bản thường. "Prose" = văn bản viết liền mạch; đối lập với dữ liệu có cấu trúc.
items.explanationEn: prose /prəʊz/ (noun): ordinary written text. Prose is continuous written text, as opposed to structured data.

items.question: Trong câu "The founding principle: requirements are fundamentally STRUCTURED, RELATED DATA, not prose.", từ "fundamentally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The founding principle: requirements are fundamentally STRUCTURED, RELATED DATA, not prose.", what does "fundamentally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: fundamentally /ˌfʌndəˈmentəli/ (trạng từ): về bản chất. "Fundamentally different" = khác nhau về bản chất.
items.explanationEn: fundamentally /ˌfʌndəˈmentəli/ (adverb): at the most basic level. "Fundamentally different" means different at the core.

items.question: Trong câu "This eliminates duplication and drift entirely.", từ "drift" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This eliminates duplication and drift entirely.", what does "drift" (noun) mean?
options: sự lệch dần khỏi thực tế
optionsEn: a slow move away from the true state
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (danh từ): sự lệch dần khỏi thực tế. "Drift" = sai lệch tích tụ dần; "configuration drift" = cấu hình lệch khỏi chuẩn.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (noun): a slow move away from the true state. Drift is gradual divergence; "configuration drift" is a common infrastructure term.

items.question: Trong câu "Automated reporting — an SRS for a release is just a report generated from the database against query criteria.", từ "criteria" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Automated reporting — an SRS for a release is just a report generated from the database against query criteria.", what does "criteria" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: standards used to judge or select
items.explanation: criteria /kraɪˈtɪəriə/ (danh từ): tiêu chí. "Criteria" là số nhiều của "criterion"; "acceptance criteria" = tiêu chí chấp nhận.
items.explanationEn: criteria /kraɪˈtɪəriə/ (noun): standards used to judge or select. Criteria is the plural of criterion; see "acceptance criteria".

items.question: Trong câu "Storing and organizing requirements with hierarchy, custom attributes, and persistent identifiers.", từ "hierarchy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Storing and organizing requirements with hierarchy, custom attributes, and persistent identifiers.", what does "hierarchy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hierarchy /ˈhaɪərɑːki/ (danh từ): cấu trúc phân cấp. "Hierarchy" = phân cấp cha-con; tính từ "hierarchical".
items.explanationEn: hierarchy /ˈhaɪərɑːki/ (noun): a structure of levels. A hierarchy arranges items in parent-child levels; adjective: hierarchical.

items.question: Trong câu "Baseline management — capturing the state of a requirement set at a point in time.", từ "capture" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Baseline management — capturing the state of a requirement set at a point in time.", what does "capture" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take control of a place
items.explanation: capture /ˈkæptʃər/ (động từ): ghi lại, lưu lại. "Capture the state/requirements" = ghi nhận lại; "capture a screenshot" = chụp màn hình.
items.explanationEn: capture /ˈkæptʃər/ (verb): to record or save. "Capture the state" means to record it; "capture a screenshot" takes an image.

items.question: Trong câu "Suspect links are an extremely valuable feature: when requirement A changes, every link from A to designs, code, and tests is automatically flagged as suspect, forcing someone to review whether those artifacts need updating.", từ "flag" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Suspect links are an extremely valuable feature: when requirement A changes, every link from A to designs, code, and tests is automatically flagged as suspect, forcing someone to review whether those artifacts need updating.", what does "flag" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: flag /flæɡ/ (động từ): đánh dấu cần chú ý. "Flag something as" = đánh dấu là; "feature flag" = cờ bật tắt tính năng.
items.explanationEn: flag /flæɡ/ (verb): to mark for attention. "Flag something as" means to mark it; a "feature flag" switches a feature on or off.

items.question: Trong câu "This is precisely what turns tracing from a static document into a living working tool.", từ "static" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is precisely what turns tracing from a static document into a living working tool.", what does "static" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: static /ˈstætɪk/ (tính từ): tĩnh, không thay đổi. "Static document" = tài liệu chết, không tự cập nhật; trái nghĩa "dynamic", "living".
items.explanationEn: static /ˈstætɪk/ (adjective): not changing or active. A "static document" does not update itself; opposites: dynamic, living.

items.question: Trong câu "Integration capability often matters more than standalone features.", từ "standalone" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integration capability often matters more than standalone features.", what does "standalone" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: standalone /ˈstændəlaʊn/ (tính từ): hoạt động độc lập. "Standalone" = tự hoạt động không phụ thuộc hệ khác, như "standalone app".
items.explanationEn: standalone /ˈstændəlaʊn/ (adjective): working on its own. Standalone means working independently, as in "a standalone app".

items.question: Trong câu "A requirements tool that does not talk to the test tool and the source control tool creates a data island nobody updates.", từ "island" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A requirements tool that does not talk to the test tool and the source control tool creates a data island nobody updates.", what does "island" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: island /ˈaɪlənd/ (danh từ): khối biệt lập. "Data island" = dữ liệu bị cô lập, không kết nối với hệ khác.
items.explanationEn: island /ˈaɪlənd/ (noun): an isolated unit. A "data island" is data cut off from other systems.

items.question: Trong câu "But it does not elicit them, does not make them clear, does not detect missing requirements, and does not resolve stakeholder conflict.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But it does not elicit them, does not make them clear, does not detect missing requirements, and does not resolve stakeholder conflict.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /ɪˈlɪsɪt/ (động từ): khơi gợi, thu thập. "Elicit requirements" = khai thác yêu cầu từ các bên; dễ nhầm với "illicit" = bất hợp pháp.
items.explanationEn: elicit /ɪˈlɪsɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. "Elicit requirements" means to draw them out; do not confuse it with illicit.

items.question: Trong câu "If the tool is hard to use, people will fall back to Word and email.", từ "fall back to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If the tool is hard to use, people will fall back to Word and email.", what does "fall back to" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to return to an old option
items.explanation: fall back to /fɔːl bæk tuː/ (cụm từ): quay về dùng cách cũ. "Fall back to" = quay lại phương án dự phòng; danh từ "fallback".
items.explanationEn: fall back to /fɔːl bæk tuː/ (phrase): to return to an old option. "Fall back to" means to return to a backup option; noun: fallback.

items.question: Trong câu "Licensing model and total cost of ownership, including maintenance fees and rollout cost.", từ "ownership" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Licensing model and total cost of ownership, including maintenance fees and rollout cost.", what does "ownership" (noun) mean?
options: việc sở hữu và vận hành
items.explanation: ownership /ˈəʊnəʃɪp/ (danh từ): việc sở hữu và vận hành. "Total cost of ownership (TCO)" = tổng chi phí sở hữu, gồm cả bảo trì và triển khai.
items.explanationEn: ownership /ˈəʊnəʃɪp/ (noun): having and running something. "Total cost of ownership" includes all costs of owning and running something.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick one pilot project with a willing team, rather than rolling out organization-wide at once.", từ "pilot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick one pilot project with a willing team, rather than rolling out organization-wide at once.", what does "pilot" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pilot /ˈpaɪlət/ (danh từ): thí điểm. "Pilot project" = dự án thí điểm trước khi triển khai rộng.
items.explanationEn: pilot /ˈpaɪlət/ (noun): a small trial. A "pilot project" is a small trial before a wide rollout.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not try to migrate everything.", từ "migrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not try to migrate everything.", what does "migrate" (verb) mean?
options: chuyển đổi, di chuyển dữ liệu
optionsEn: to move data to a new system
items.explanation: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi, di chuyển dữ liệu. "Migrate data" = chuyển dữ liệu sang hệ mới; danh từ "migration".
items.explanationEn: migrate /maɪˈɡreɪt/ (verb): to move data to a new system. "Migrate data" means to move it to a new system; noun: migration.

items.question: Trong câu "A tool amplifies the process you have — for better or worse.", từ "amplify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tool amplifies the process you have — for better or worse.", what does "amplify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: amplify /ˈæmplɪfaɪ/ (động từ): khuếch đại, làm tăng. "Amplify" = khuếch đại cả điểm tốt lẫn điểm xấu; nghĩa gốc là tăng âm lượng.
items.explanationEn: amplify /ˈæmplɪfaɪ/ (verb): to make stronger. Amplify means to intensify good and bad alike; literally to make a sound louder.

items.question: Trong câu "If your process is chaotic, the tool makes it chaotic faster and at larger scale.", từ "chaotic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If your process is chaotic, the tool makes it chaotic faster and at larger scale.", what does "chaotic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: chaotic /keɪˈɒtɪk/ (tính từ): hỗn loạn. "Chaotic" tính từ của "chaos" = sự hỗn loạn.
items.explanationEn: chaotic /keɪˈɒtɪk/ (adjective): completely disorganized. Chaotic is the adjective of chaos.

items.question: Trong câu "Without an owner, the tool drifts into abandonment.", từ "abandonment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without an owner, the tool drifts into abandonment.", what does "abandonment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: abandonment /əˈbændənmənt/ (danh từ): sự bị bỏ rơi. "Drift into abandonment" = dần dần bị bỏ mặc; động từ "abandon".
items.explanationEn: abandonment /əˈbændənmənt/ (noun): being left unused. "Drift into abandonment" means slowly being left unused; verb: abandon.

items.question: Trong câu "The tool becomes the goal instead of the means.", từ "means" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The tool becomes the goal instead of the means.", what does "means" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: means /miːnz/ (danh từ): phương tiện, cách thức. "The means, not the goal" = phương tiện chứ không phải mục đích; "by means of" = bằng cách.
items.explanationEn: means /miːnz/ (noun): a way of achieving something. "The means, not the goal" contrasts method with purpose; "by means of" means using.

items.question: Trong câu "If you notice people debating custom-field configuration while nobody has spoken to a real user in three weeks, you have lost the plot.", từ "lose the plot" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you notice people debating custom-field configuration while nobody has spoken to a real user in three weeks, you have lost the plot.", what does "lose the plot" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to lose a piece of land
items.explanation: lose the plot /luːz ðə plɒt/ (cụm từ): quên mất mục tiêu chính. "Lose the plot" (thân mật) = mất phương hướng, quên điều quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: lose the plot /luːz ðə plɒt/ (phrase): to forget what really matters. "Lose the plot" (informal) means to lose sight of what matters.

items.question: Trong câu "The result: people fill in anything to get past the form, and the data becomes worthless.", từ "worthless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The result: people fill in anything to get past the form, and the data becomes worthless.", what does "worthless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worthless /ˈwɜːθləs/ (tính từ): vô giá trị. "Worthless" = vô giá trị; đừng nhầm với "priceless" = vô giá.
items.explanationEn: worthless /ˈwɜːθləs/ (adjective): having no value. Worthless means of no value; do not confuse it with priceless.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most serious failure mode.", từ "failure mode" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most serious failure mode.", what does "failure mode" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: failure mode /ˈfeɪljə məʊd/ (danh từ): kiểu thất bại. "Failure mode" = cách thức một hệ thống/quy trình có thể hỏng.
items.explanationEn: failure mode /ˈfeɪljə məʊd/ (noun): a way something can fail. A "failure mode" is a particular way a system or process can fail.

items.question: Trong câu "You paid for a database and are using it as a filing cabinet.", từ "filing cabinet" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You paid for a database and are using it as a filing cabinet.", what does "filing cabinet" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: filing cabinet /ˈfaɪlɪŋ ˌkæbɪnət/ (danh từ): tủ đựng hồ sơ. "Filing cabinet" = tủ hồ sơ; ở đây ám chỉ chỉ cất giữ mà không khai thác.
items.explanationEn: filing cabinet /ˈfaɪlɪŋ ˌkæbɪnət/ (noun): a cupboard for documents. A filing cabinet stores papers; here it implies storing without using.

items.question: Trong câu "Tracing becomes manual work and is quickly abandoned.", từ "manual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tracing becomes manual work and is quickly abandoned.", what does "manual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: manual /ˈmænjuəl/ (tính từ): làm bằng tay, thủ công. "Manual work/testing" = làm thủ công; danh từ "a manual" = sách hướng dẫn.
items.explanationEn: manual /ˈmænjuəl/ (adjective): done by hand. "Manual testing" is done by people; as a noun, a manual is a guide book.

items.question: Trong câu "If stakeholders will not participate, if nobody has decision authority, if the organization cannot agree on priorities — no tool fixes any of that.", từ "participate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If stakeholders will not participate, if nobody has decision authority, if the organization cannot agree on priorities — no tool fixes any of that.", what does "participate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: participate /pɑːˈtɪsɪpeɪt/ (động từ): tham gia. "Participate in" = tham gia vào; danh từ "participation".
items.explanationEn: participate /pɑːˈtɪsɪpeɪt/ (verb): to take part. "Participate in" means to take part; noun: participation.

items.question: Trong câu "the tool is a burden rather than an asset.", từ "asset" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the tool is a burden rather than an asset.", what does "asset" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a static file such as an image
items.explanation: asset /ˈæset/ (danh từ): tài sản có ích. "An asset" = thứ có giá trị; trong web, "assets" là file tĩnh như ảnh, CSS.
items.explanationEn: asset /ˈæset/ (noun): a useful resource. An asset is something valuable; in web development, assets are static files.

items.question: Trong câu "Requirements work is supported by a whole ecosystem.", từ "ecosystem" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Requirements work is supported by a whole ecosystem.", what does "ecosystem" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ecosystem /ˈiːkəʊsɪstəm/ (danh từ): hệ sinh thái công cụ. "Tool ecosystem" = tập hợp công cụ liên kết với nhau; nghĩa gốc là hệ sinh thái tự nhiên.
items.explanationEn: ecosystem /ˈiːkəʊsɪstəm/ (noun): a connected set of tools. A "tool ecosystem" is a connected set of tools; literally, a natural community.

items.question: Trong câu "Drawing DFDs, ERDs, state diagrams, swimlanes; enforcing notation rules and catching syntax errors", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Drawing DFDs, ERDs, state diagrams, swimlanes; enforcing notation rules and catching syntax errors", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): bắt buộc tuân thủ. "Enforce rules/policies" = buộc tuân thủ; "law enforcement" = thực thi pháp luật.
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make rules be followed. "Enforce rules" means to ensure they are followed; see "law enforcement".

items.question: Trong câu "Building interface mock-ups quickly for feedback", từ "mock-up" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Building interface mock-ups quickly for feedback", what does "mock-up" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mock-up /ˈmɒk ʌp/ (danh từ): bản mô phỏng giao diện. "Mock-up" = bản dựng thử để lấy phản hồi; động từ "mock" còn là chế giễu.
items.explanationEn: mock-up /ˈmɒk ʌp/ (noun): a model of a design. A mock-up is a draft model for feedback; the verb mock also means to ridicule.

items.question: Trong câu "Glossaries, business rules, architectural decisions and rationale", từ "glossary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Glossaries, business rules, architectural decisions and rationale", what does "glossary" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list of terms and meanings
items.explanation: glossary /ˈɡlɒsəri/ (danh từ): bảng thuật ngữ. "Glossary" = bảng giải thích thuật ngữ, giúp mọi người dùng từ thống nhất.
items.explanationEn: glossary /ˈɡlɒsəri/ (noun): a list of terms and meanings. A glossary explains terms so everyone uses words consistently.

items.question: Trong câu "A simple tool used consistently beats a powerful tool that gets avoided.", từ "consistently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple tool used consistently beats a powerful tool that gets avoided.", what does "consistently" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách đều đặn, nhất quán
items.explanation: consistently /kənˈsɪstəntli/ (trạng từ): một cách đều đặn, nhất quán. "Use consistently" = dùng đều đặn theo cùng một cách.
items.explanationEn: consistently /kənˈsɪstəntli/ (adverb): regularly in the same way. "Used consistently" means used regularly in the same way.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not let the tool dictate the process.", từ "dictate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not let the tool dictate the process.", what does "dictate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (động từ): quyết định, áp đặt. "Dictate" = áp đặt; nghĩa khác là đọc cho người khác chép.
items.explanationEn: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (verb): to control or decide. Dictate means to impose; it also means to speak words for someone to write down.

items.question: Trong câu "If they merely create work nobody queries the results of, scale them back.", từ "scale back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If they merely create work nobody queries the results of, scale them back.", what does "scale back" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: scale back /skeɪl bæk/ (cụm từ): thu hẹp, giảm bớt. "Scale back" = cắt giảm quy mô; trái nghĩa "scale up".
items.explanationEn: scale back /skeɪl bæk/ (phrase): to reduce in size. "Scale back" means to reduce in size or amount; opposite: scale up.

items.question: Trong câu "Partial adoption creates two sources of truth, both incomplete.", từ "adoption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Partial adoption creates two sources of truth, both incomplete.", what does "adoption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: adoption /əˈdɒpʃən/ (danh từ): việc áp dụng. "Tool adoption" = mức độ đưa công cụ vào sử dụng; nghĩa khác là nhận con nuôi.
items.explanationEn: adoption /əˈdɒpʃən/ (noun): starting to use something. "Tool adoption" means taking a tool into use; it also means adopting a child.

items.question: Trong câu "A tool does NOT give you good requirements — weak analysis skills just yield bad requirements organized attractively.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tool does NOT give you good requirements — weak analysis skills just yield bad requirements organized attractively.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): tạo ra, dẫn đến. "Yield results" = mang lại kết quả; "yield" còn nghĩa nhường đường, khuất phục.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce as a result. "Yield results" means to produce them; yield can also mean to give way.

items.question: Trong câu "Usability determines success more than the feature list — a hard-to-use tool gets abandoned.", từ "usability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Usability determines success more than the feature list — a hard-to-use tool gets abandoned.", what does "usability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: usability /ˌjuːzəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): tính dễ sử dụng. "Usability" = mức độ dễ dùng; khác "usefulness" (hữu ích) và "availability" (sẵn sàng hoạt động).
items.explanationEn: usability /ˌjuːzəˈbɪləti/ (noun): ease of use. Usability is ease of use, different from usefulness and availability.

items.question: Trong câu "No tool fixes human problems — absent stakeholders, no decision authority.", từ "absent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No tool fixes human problems — absent stakeholders, no decision authority.", what does "absent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: absent /ˈæbsənt/ (tính từ): vắng mặt, không tham gia. "Absent stakeholders" = các bên liên quan không tham gia; "absent-minded" = đãng trí.
items.explanationEn: absent /ˈæbsənt/ (adjective): not present or involved. "Absent stakeholders" do not take part; "absent-minded" means forgetful.

items.question: Trong câu "The main value is impact analysis, coverage measurement, detecting missing and superfluous functionality, supporting maintenance, and proving compliance.", từ "coverage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The main value is impact analysis, coverage measurement, detecting missing and superfluous functionality, supporting maintenance, and proving compliance.", what does "coverage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: coverage /ˈkʌvərɪdʒ/ (danh từ): mức độ bao phủ. "Test coverage" = mức độ yêu cầu/mã được kiểm thử bao phủ; "media coverage" = đưa tin.
items.explanationEn: coverage /ˈkʌvərɪdʒ/ (noun): the extent something is covered. "Test coverage" measures how much is tested; "media coverage" is news reporting.
